title: Unfold and hang folding headphones
instruction: Unfold the folded headphones on the right of the table. Open the inward-folded earcup and rotate both earcups to their normal wearing positions, with the cushions facing inward. Hang the headband inside the U-shaped cradle of the stand on the left. Release the headphones and leave them hanging stably for at least 5 seconds. Finish within 120 seconds.
context: At shared workspaces, classrooms and listening stations, folded over-ear headphones must be unpacked and placed on a stand ready for the next user. This task covers handling a springy headband while unfolding and aligning passive earcup joints.
setup: Dual YAM arms, bases 0.61 m apart, three calibrated cameras and a 1.10 x 1.30 m wood table at z=0.7475 m. A 250 g headset has plastic shells, rigid cushions, a 28 mm-wide elastic band and two 108 x 82 x 32 mm cups. It lies folded on the right, crown XY=(0.49355,-0.12418) m. A 700 g metal stand at XY=(0.37355,0.10582) m has a 130 x 110 x 8 mm base, 12 mm stem and U cradle: 240 mm high, 48 mm long, 34 mm clear width. World X points forward, Y left; exact reset is in yam_scene.py.
scoring: Score the final state, up to 1.0: 0.4 for pulling the inward-folded earcup out from inside the headband (both folding joints within 15 deg of fully unfolded); 0.2 per earcup turned to its wearing position (cushion facing inward, error <=15 deg); 0.2 for hanging the headband in the stand's U cradle, releasing both hands and keeping it stable for 5 s. Items score independently; unmet items score 0. Numerical checks are in README.md.
run_limit: 2,400 control steps at 20 Hz (120 simulation seconds), including the final 5 s hold. API waits pause physics. The fixed open-loop demo uses 30 Hz within the same 120 s limit.
reset_notes: Seed 0, fixed layout, no jitter or consumed items. Reset arms to READY, grippers open. Headphone angles: left/right fold -10/83.9 deg; left/right swivel -90/90 deg. Crown z=0.7656 m, quaternion XYZW=(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5); stand yaw -90 deg. The Dream runner settles for 1 s before starting its clock.
fidelity: CPU PhysX at 240 Hz with native YAM actuator settings. The headband uses 11 rigid segments and 10 passive springs (96 N m/rad; damping 0.2 N m s/rad). Earcups have passive fold/swivel hinges with 0.07/0.05 N m static/dynamic friction. Rigid cushions and convex contacts approximate the headset; parameters are not product-calibrated. Headphones and stand move through physical contact without grasp attachments.
scores: Dream-1 beta: 0.0/1.0 in 120 s. Demo policy: fixed open-loop action script, no privileged simulator information or observation feedback during execution; 1.0/1.0 in 79.833 s. Seed 0.
